# Nyota & Bilkack — Wedding Memorial

> A cinematic memorial of Nyota and Bilkack's wedding day, 16 May 2026, at Vosh · Ministry of Repentance and Holiness.

This site is a single-page editorial film documenting the chapters of the day: getting ready, the ceremony, reception, gifts, the party, the bridal party, both families, an archive gallery, and the wedding film.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The full cinematic memorial — chapters, gallery, film, and credits.
